svg.title: Do I need KYC on Redbelly?
svg.desc: KYC is needed for anything you sign on Redbelly mainnet. Needed: bridge out, send or swap, stake. Not needed: RBNT on an exchange, wrapped RBNT on another chain. Unconfirmed: bridge into mainnet.
svg.text: KYC is needed for anything you sign on Redbelly mainnet
Chain ID 151. Anywhere else, no Redbelly KYC.
Nothing is signed on Redbelly Network.
Hold wrapped RBNT on another chain
The token lives on another chain.
No official page says. Enable your wallet first.
Send, swap or use apps on mainnet
Write access needs an enabled account.
Native vs wrapped. Signing on Redbelly (chain ID 151) needs KYC. Wrapped
RBNT on another chain does not.
DAO vs network. The DAO is open to general members from any
region. High Council and leadership limits remain. The
network does not offer services in 18 jurisdictions
Sources are listed in the full guide.
